competitive_judgment: Both preparations provide direct pharmacological challenge-protection evidence worth retaining. No useful muscle outcome or BUB1B-deficient rescue; no demonstrated superiority over provisional niacin/apitegromab, whose MVA efficacy also remains unproved. No individual-component or whole-food benefit transfer.
